question: In a race around a circular track, an athlete runs at 10 m/sec in the first round, at 20 m/sec in the second round, and at 30 m/sec in the third round. Find his average speed (in m/sec) for the race. (correct to 2 decimal places)
solution:
**Given:**

Speed in 1st round = 10 m/sec

Speed in 2nd round = 20 m/sec

Speed in 3rd round = 30 m/sec

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

Average speed = Total distance covered/Total time taken

**Solution:**

Let the circular track be x m,

By the above formula, 

Time taken by A = x/10

Time taken by B = x/20

Time taken by C = x/30

Average Speed = Total distance covered/Total time taken,

⇒ Average Speed = {(x + x + x)over{xover10}+{xover20} + {xover30}}

⇒ Average Speed = {3xover{(6x + 3x + 2x) over60}}

⇒ Average Speed = (60 × 3x)/11x

⇒ Average Speed = 180/11 = 16.36

**∴ Average speed is 16.36 m/sec.**
